summary: C++ exception throw wrapper for std::out_of_range. Constructs the exception object with a vtable via ObjectInitWithVTable_b038, invokes the throw path CxxThrowException8 with the out_of_range type-info global __TI3?AVout_of_range@std@@ over a stack buffer, then runs the SEH unwind cleanup ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH. If the allocation flag bit in the stack buffer is set, frees the heap-allocated object via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then returns the object pointer.

operations.description: Construct the exception object by calling ObjectInitWithVTable_b038 on the this pointer, establishing the vtable before the throw.
Invoke the C++ throw path CxxThrowException8 with the stack buffer and the std::out_of_range type-info global __TI3?AVout_of_range@std@@.
Run the SEH unwind cleanup path ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH over the saved registers frame.
Test the allocation flag bit of the stack buffer via (v5[4] & 1); when set, heap memory was allocated and must be freed.
Conditionally free the heap-allocated object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the allocation flag bit is set.
